title: The four seasons of money
hook: Does any of this repeat, or is every year a brand new mess?
metaphor: Money has seasons like weather. Growth, then a hot top, then a cold slowdown, then a thaw. The order rarely changes.
body: In growth, jobs are plentiful and shares tend to do well.
At the top, prices rise fast and the Fed starts pressing the brakes.
In the slowdown, jobs are lost and safe things do best.
In the thaw, the Fed helps again and the cycle restarts.

live.template: It is currently {needle}, and the engine puts about {prob}% confidence on that read.

caveat: Seasons blur at the edges. The engine gives a best guess with odds, not a certainty.
